hero.label: Made for Vooma
hero.headline: I'll help Vooma make customer deployments smoother and faster.
hero.subheadline: My background is a mix of outbound execution, client facing work, and operating in fast moving teams. Vooma's deployment role sits right at the intersection of customer success, operations, and problem solving, which is where I can add value quickly.

whyCompany.title: I like messy operational work
whyCompany.body: At early stage companies the real work is often unglamorous. I am comfortable learning workflows fast, staying organized, and helping customers get to value without drama.

whyCompany.title: Customer facing without losing the details
whyCompany.body: The mix of communication, follow through, and process management is a strong fit. I can handle people well while still keeping the operational side tight.

whyCompany.title: The logistics problem is real
whyCompany.body: Vooma is not selling hype. It is automating quoting and order entry for logistics teams, which are painful manual workflows with obvious ROI when fixed.

quote: I would be excited to help Vooma turn complex deployments into a repeatable, customer friendly process.
